situation (example wording): A percent change that lands exactly on a half of a tenth, such as 1,600 to 1,500 (-6.25%) or 1,600 to 1,700 (+6.25%).
what the app does today: A drop landing on a half rounded up (toward zero): -6.25 showed -6.2 while +6.25 showed +6.3.
proposed behavior: A percent change that lands exactly on a half rounds away from zero for both signs: -6.25 shows -6.3 and +6.25 shows +6.3. This applies to every percent-change path (scorecard change column, current trends change, agency and historical scorecards, year-over-year comparison).
